import zlib, struct
def write_png(path, W, H, px):
    """px: bytearray W*H*3"""
    raw = b''.join(b'\x00' + bytes(px[y*W*3:(y+1)*W*3]) for y in range(H))
    def chunk(t, d): return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t + d) & 0xffffffff)
    open(path, 'wb').write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', W, H, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)) + chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw, 9)) + chunk(b'IEND', b''))
# 5x7 font for labels
F = {'A':'01110100011000111111100011000110001','B':'11110100011000111110100011000111110','C':'01110100011000010000100001000101110','D':'11110100011000110001100011000111110','E':'11111100001000011110100001000011111','F':'11111100001000011110100001000010000','G':'01110100011000010111100011000101111','H':'10001100011000111111100011000110001','I':'01110001000010000100001000010001110','K':'10001100101010011000101001001010001','L':'10000100001000010000100001000011111','M':'10001110111010110101100011000110001','N':'10001110011010110011100011000110001','O':'01110100011000110001100011000101110','P':'11110100011000111110100001000010000','R':'11110100011000111110101001001010001','S':'01111100001000001110000010000111110','T':'11111001000010000100001000010000100','U':'10001100011000110001100011000101110','V':'10001100011000110001100010101000100','W':'10001100011000110101101011101110001','Y':'10001100010101000100001000010000100','Z':'11111000010001000100010001000011111','0':'01110100011001110101110011000101110','1':'00100011000010000100001000010001110','2':'01110100010000100010001000100011111','3':'11110000010000101110000010000111110','4':'00010001100101010010111110001000010','5':'11111100001111000001000011000101110','6':'00110010001000011110100011000101110','7':'11111000010001000100010000100001000','8':'01110100011000101110100011000101110','9':'01110100011000101111000010001001100',' ':'0'*35,'-':'00000000000000011111000000000000000','/':'00001000010001000100010001000010000','.':'0'*30+'00100','=':'00000000001111100000111110000000000',':':'00000001000000000000000000010000000','>':'10000010000010000010001000100010000','(':'00010001000100001000010000010000010',')':'01000001000001000010000100010001000','+':'00000001000010011111001000010000000','%':'11001110010001000100010001001110011','_':'0'*30+'11111'}
def text(px, W, H, x, y, s, col, scale=1):
    for ch in s.upper():
        g = F.get(ch, F[' '])
        for i, b in enumerate(g):
            if b == '1':
                for sx in range(scale):
                    for sy in range(scale):
                        X, Y = x + (i % 5) * scale + sx, y + (i // 5) * scale + sy
                        if 0 <= X < W and 0 <= Y < H: px[(Y*W+X)*3:(Y*W+X)*3+3] = bytes(col)
        x += 6 * scale
